::: {.label}
Artefact · Web tool · Design · 2026
:::

A small tool for making a mark: a favicon, an app tile, an avatar. You pick one of 371,000 icons, or type a few letters, and set it inside a polygon whose sides, rotation, corner radius and colours you control. It exports an SVG that scales to any size, or a PNG from 64 to 1024 pixels. The marks on this site were made with it.

The tagline is the brief: set a mark, prove it at 16px. The preview shows the mark in a browser tab at 16 pixels, as an app tile and as an avatar, because that is where it has to work. When the icon and its fill drop below 3:1 contrast, the page says so. It is a warning rather than a block, but at 16 pixels a faint mark disappears.

## Privacy

There is no account, and nothing you make is stored on a server. Choosing letters does ask Google Fonts for the characters you typed, so it can send back just those letterforms.

## Licences

The icons come from 238 open icon sets through Iconify, and each set has its own licence. Most are free to use, some need attribution, and a few restrict commercial use. Brand logos are trademarks. Check a set's terms before you ship a mark built from it.
